string.name: auth_live_privacy_body
string.value:
Authenticator service names, accounts, setup keys and parameters are stored in an encrypted ArkData database on this device. Database encryption keys are managed by the system. TimeAuth does not upload these records to its own server or download service icons.

App unlock is off by default and can be enabled in Settings. When enabled, system identity verification gates access; TimeAuth does not receive your device password or biometric templates. Whether App unlock is enabled or not, backgrounding closes the active authenticator session and releases decoded credentials and generated codes; when App unlock is off, returning to the foreground reopens the session automatically. JavaScript memory cannot be guaranteed to be physically erased.

Scanning uses the system Scan Kit interface and its camera/gallery controls. A supported QR code is reviewed before you save it. Tapping a code writes it to the system clipboard; automatic clearing follows your settings.

Backup, export, cloud sync, HOTP and batch migration are not implemented. Uninstalling, clearing app data or losing the device may lose keys. Keep service recovery codes. Password Vault remains a separate preview; password generation and authenticators are real features.
